title: fix: make CatGPT and Opposite Prompt bots mention-only
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: CatGPT and Opposite Prompt drop Discord’s Message Content gateway intent, which caused both bots to crash-loop after their privileged-intent access was removed. Both now answer only messages that @mention them; plain messages in their channels are ignored. Opposite Prompt no longer requires OPPOSITE_PROMPT_CHANNEL_ID. CatGPT retains its channel for catch-up and the ask CLI, and its status now reads “Mention me to ask 😾”.
